title: Generative AI Masterclass
description: Comprehensive roadmap and production training for Generative AI, LLMs, and Foundation Models using LangChain, RAG, LCEL Runnables, and Autonomous AI Agents.
eligibility: Basic proficiency in Python and foundational Software Development Concepts.
whatYouWillLearn: Master Nitish's Generative AI 2027 Roadmap covering both the Builder's Track and User's Track.
Integrate Foundation Models (LLMs) via OpenAI, Ollama, and HuggingFace within modular LangChain pipelines.
Design advanced Prompts, dynamic PromptTemplates, and Few-Shot In-Context learning sequences.
Enforce strictly validated JSON schemas and structured outputs using PydanticOutputParser.
Construct high-performance Runnable sequences using the LangChain Expression Language (LCEL).
Build production-grade RAG pipelines with Document Loaders, Semantic Text Splitters, and Vector Stores.

title: AI & Deep Learning Foundations Mastery
description: Master neural networks, PyTorch tensors, transformer attention architectures, and scalable cloud deployment from foundational math to advanced generative vision systems.
eligibility: High school mathematics and basic Python scripting knowledge.
whatYouWillLearn: Understand differential calculus, linear algebra, and backpropagation mechanics from first principles.
Build deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Recurrent architectures in raw PyTorch.
Implement Multi-Head Self-Attention mechanisms and modern Transformer decoder blocks.
Optimize generative neural architectures using quantization (LoRA, QLoRA) and pruning.
Deploy scalable inference microservices using Docker, FastAPI, and AWS GPU cluster instances.
